description: Type-C step-up (boost) lithium battery charging module, 2S/3S/4S selectable; the unit in hand is the 3S 4A version

ports.label: BAT / GND
ports.note: valores da versão 3S 4A; só carrega — não balanceia as células nem protege o pack em uso

specs.function: charges a series lithium pack from a 5 V USB-C source by boosting the voltage; it is a charger only, it does not balance cells and does not protect the pack in use

output.note: values for the 3S 4A version; the same board family does 8.4 V (2S) and 16.8 V (4S), and 1 A / 2 A versions give proportionally lower charging current

specs.configuration: solder jumpers on the back select the series count (2S / 3S / 4S) and the input current (1A / 2A / 4A)
features: quasi-CV mode, compensates the voltage drop of the cell internal resistance and wiring
automatic recharge when the pack falls below the threshold

connections.VIN / GND (input side): optional DC input in place of the USB-C connector
